name: Flicker polish
objective: Fix the account dropdown's caret swap (▾/▴ differ in width so the frame jumps on toggle); hunt and fix other visible flicker across every user-facing page, desktop and mobile, in the operator runtime and production.

review.note: All 15 slices validated together; every fix re-measured with controls on dev, a fresh production build and production 004d936; gate stages run; 19-line Doc impact list verified; Q1-Q9 and four residuals routed (D47, D48, D49, walkthrough); qa v0018. Gate cleared by the operator 2026-09-05.

acceptance.walkthrough:
**0. Before you start.**

1. Open **`https://jujutower.com`** in your own browser — that is the runtime this phase shipped to,
   at release `004d936`. Everything below is visible **anonymously**: do not sign in, do not send
   feedback, do not ask a question if you would rather not spend a model call. Nothing here deploys,
   and the freeze is **2026-09-07 11:00 KST**.
2. This phase removed **motion**, not pixels. The resting look of every surface is unchanged on
   purpose, so what you are checking is mostly an **absence**: things that used to jump no longer do.
   Load each page **cold** (hard reload) and watch the first second.

**1. The five fixes — look for what no longer happens.**

3. Reload **`/`** and watch the top-right corner. 「로그인」 and the **AI 질문** launcher are there in
   the very first paint; they no longer appear a beat late. Try `/stocks`, `/portfolio` and an event
   page — same on all ten public routes.
4. Open a stock you hold — **`/stocks/{종목}`** — enter a 보유량, then come back to the page. The
   ① 환산 row's cells fill **inside a box that was already the right size**: the numbers appear, but
    the 놓친 돈 block below them does not get pushed down any more.
5. Open any **`/events/{접수번호}`** and press **「정정 이력」**, then **「접기 ×」**, a few times. The
   button keeps **one width** — it used to shrink every time you opened it.
6. On **`/stocks`** type a company that does not exist, press Enter, then type one more character.
   The 「…과 일치하는 종목이 없습니다」 sentence disappears but the **space it occupied stays**, so nothing
   below jumps up.
7. **Slow connection check** (throttle to 3G in your browser's dev tools, or use a phone on a weak
   signal): load a stock page and watch the numerals. The monospace figures no longer re-flow when
   the font finishes loading.
8. **On your phone**, open **`/portfolio`** in sample mode, delete a row, and reload. The deleted row
   is simply never drawn — you no longer see it appear and then vanish.

**2. Four residuals I did not fix. Please accept or reject each.**

9. **DECISION A — 조회 revisit reflow.** Open a stock that shows **놓친 돈** rows, enter a 보유량, then
   revisit the page. The breakdown still slides up about **140 px** once. It is **exactly the same on
   the old build** — this phase neither caused nor cured it — and fixing it means measuring row
   heights that depend on served text. *My recommendation:* accept for now and let me file it as a
   deferred job (job 2 above). **Accept / fix now?**
10. **DECISION B — the ① 환산 row's two-stage draw.** On a slow connection the row's box appears
    first and its cells land 7–20 ms later. The box, the page height and everything below are
    **immobile** — it is a fill, not a flicker, and the browser records no layout shift for it.
    *My recommendation:* accept as is. **Accept?**
11. **DECISION C — two sample-mode residuals.** (a) On a phone, overriding a 보유량 can re-wrap one
    past ① row — identical on the old build. (b) Removing **every** issuer swaps the list for the
    「없습니다」 empty panel, which grows 33.5 → 106.44 px; the old build collapsed 1324 → 900 px in the
    same state, so this is **better** than before. *My recommendation:* accept both as is. **Accept?**

**3. Five open questions. One decision each.**

12. **DECISION D (Q7 + Q9 — one rule for both).** Press 보내기 on **`/ask`** and in **의견 보내기**: the
    button you just pressed changes label (답변 준비 중… / 보내는 중입니다) and therefore changes width,
    which slides the composer beside it. I can stop the motion, but only by making the **resting**
    button as wide as its widest label — **+40.8 px** on `/ask` and **+53.47 px** on 의견 보내기, at
    rest, in a signed dialog. **May a send button's resting box be as wide as its widest label?**
    Answer once and I will apply it to both.
13. **DECISION E (Q8 — the login panel).** Open **`/auth/login`** and switch to 계정 만들기. The panel
    grows **+20.9 px** because the intro wraps to a second line. I can reserve that line in both
    modes — after which nothing moves — at the cost of **one blank line of empty panel at rest**, at
    both viewports, on the page readers land on. **Reserve the line, or leave the panel as signed?**
14. **DECISION F (Q3 — the board re-ranking under you).** Leave **`/`** open for a minute or two. The
    board refreshes on its own and can re-rank rows and shift the freshness stamp while you are
    reading. **Keep it live, wait for a quiet moment, or require an explicit 새로고침?**
15. **DECISION G (Q6 — keyboard focus after the widget closes).** Open the AI 질문 widget and close it
    with its ×. Focus lands at the top of the tab cycle rather than back on the launcher.
    Pre-existing, never settled in the record. **Restore focus to the launcher, or leave it?**
16. **DECISION H (Q4 — the launcher's hover).** Hover the AI 질문 launcher: the sparkle grows
    **32 → 43.2 px**. It moves nothing else and it is the only hover in the product that changes
    geometry. *My recommendation:* keep as signed. **Keep or soften?**

**4. What I noticed with fresh eyes — not judged against the design record, and not fixed.**

17. **On your phone**, try to tick a 챙겼습니다 box on `/portfolio`. The target is **15 × 15 px** and it
    is genuinely fiddly. Pre-existing and untouched by this phase, but it is the same family as the
    still-open 「≤767 chip target is 14 × 16 px」 decision from P11. Worth deciding both together.
18. Open a **bad event address**, e.g. `/events/00000000000000`. The page paints empty for a beat
    before the Korean not-found copy arrives. Status is correctly 404; it just reads as broken first.
19. The send-button growth in item 12 is the thing I noticed as a *reader*, not as a ruler: the
    control you just pressed changes size while you are still looking at it.

**5. After you walk it.**

20. If everything above is acceptable: clear the gate — `python3 scripts/workflow.py accept-gate P12
    --clear --note "..."` — and tell me your answers to **A–H**; I will turn each 「fix now」 into a
    fix slice and file the rest.
21. If something is wrong: say what you saw and where, and it is recorded as
    `review-phase P12 --verdict changes_requested --note "operator-reported: ..."` and cut into fix
    slices — no need to soften it.
22. Two jobs I want filed either way: **`scrollbar-gutter` unverifiable on macOS** and the **조회
    revisit reflow** (full text in § Stage D).
acceptance.note: Cleared on the operator's say-so ('close the phase', 2026-09-05) without per-item answers to walkthrough decisions A-H. A is D48, Q5 is D47, B and C accepted as the review recommended; D-H (Q7+Q9, Q8, Q3, Q6, Q4) stay open as D49.
